name: @ait-kit/api-client
description: Typed HTTP client helpers for Apps in Toss mTLS proxy services.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format esm --target browser --packages external && bun build src/node/index.ts --outfile dist/node/index.js --format esm --target node --packages external
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@ait-kit/api-core' build && bun run build && bun test test
